notes.title: Demo Bug Patch
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795917/7a84e8ddc88814df76292a40b7a0c0cf63c3c983.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795917/ac06060ee435e29be0569bdd8e231880509c12f2.png[/img][/url]

[u][h1]Patch notes for demo[/h1][/u]

[list]
[*]Can no longer spam input keys to exploit prompts.
[*]Fixed bug where skill tree would not show what was selected.
[*]Fixed bug where you could select a skill tree node multiple times and it would spend your skill points.
[*]Fixed bug where skill tree powers were not resetting when the player prestige.
[*] Added Plinko and slot machine mini-games.
[*] Changed CQX voice lines.
[*] Fixed bug where Level 3 lighting not shooting out sparks.
[*]Fixed bug where in the middle of dialog you could trigger another and it would cut off the voice line currently playing.
[*]Added IDubbbz Toastyyyyy meme when the player prestige.
[*]Fixed UI bug with the Ads, Merch and Controversy generators where it would show the cost as 0 as the first purchase.
[*] Fixed bug where when buying subs after the player has prestige it would skyrocket in price to a very high denomination.
[*] Changed UI loading text.
[*] Fixed bug where arrow keys would control the radio volume slider.
[*] Fixed bug where you were not earning skill points when skill point buff is active.
[/list]

Thanks so much for all the help with bugs and recommendations if you find anything please use the bug report tool and I will get on it.

notes.title: Performance Upgrade
notes.notes:
Performance Update!!!
[list]
[*]Made changes to code for better performance (object pooling and getting rid of some code bottlenecks that effect performance.)
[*]Added offline progression for demo.
[*] Fixed Game Objects causing a crash when spawning to many.
[*]Added end game when reaching a certain amount of revenue earned.
[/list]

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed Issues where streamers voice lines would duplicate and play at an annoying rate. They now sound off at a staggered pace from the last and will not duplicate until all have played.
[*] Added more CQX voice lines.
[*] Fixed Ad Break Power Menu, power ups were enabled when they were suppose to be on cool down. I added a timer to show when the cool down ends and disabled the buttons when cool down is in effect.
[/list]
